指定された場所はガレムグラード山脈の一角だった。\nここはメイズのポータル・ゼロ: The designated location was a corner of the Garemgrad Mountains. This place was also quite close to the Maze's Portal Zero.
確かにこの付近なら、風紀委員会も察知しづらいでしょうね……: Indeed, if it's around here, even the Disciplinary Committee would have a hard time detecting us...
あちらさんはすでにお待ちかねらしい。: It seems like they're already waiting for us.
指示されたポイントに双頭の斧の一部隊が展開している。\nおそらく見えているだけで: A unit from the Double-Headed Axe is deployed at the instructed point. That's likely not all of them, either.
――シリウスシュガーの５機は、\n双頭の斧の機体達の前に着陸した。: —The five units of Sirius Sugar landed in front of the Double-Headed Axe's machines.
そっちが変な気起こさないように、こっちも一応武装はしてきた。\nこれくらいは大目: We armed ourselves just in case so you wouldn't try anything funny. I hope you'll overlook at least this much.
……構わないわ。でもあんたは相変わらず武装しないのね。: ...I don't mind. But as usual, you aren't carrying any weapons, are you?
設計段階から想定されてなくてな……: That wasn't even accounted for in the design phase...
気が合うな、俺も心の底からそう思うよ……: Great minds think alike. I think so from the bottom of my heart too...
まあ、いいわ。交渉を始めましょう。: Oh well, fine. Let's begin the negotiations.
人質交換ではなく交渉か。\nどうやら話し合いをする気はあると思っていいようだ。: Negotiations rather than a hostage exchange, huh. Looks like we can assume she's actually willing to talk.
まずは龍宮ちゆると１対１で、それも直接会話をしたい。\nこの場に来ていることの確: First, I want to speak directly one-on-one with Tatsumiya Chiyuru. That includes confirming that she has actually come here.
ＭＧの通信機越しではいけませんの？: Is doing it over the MG comms not good enough?
傍受される可能性があるし、この目で姿を見ることができない。: There's a risk of interception, and I wouldn't be able to see her with my own eyes.
龍宮ちゆる以外は距離を取り、機体で待機していろ。\n我々の会話を聞くことは許さな: Everyone other than Tatsumiya Chiyuru, fall back and stand by in your units. I will not allow anyone to eavesdrop on our conversation.
指揮官機が示した先に生体反応がある。カメラをズームさせると、\n縄で縛られて地面: There was a life sign in the direction the commander unit indicated. Zooming in with the camera revealed Julie tied up with rope and sitting on the ground.
左右には合計２機の双頭の斧の下っ端の機体が、\n彼女を守るように立っている。: To her left and right stood a total of two Double-Headed Axe henchmen units, standing as if guarding her.
……その上でこちらからも条件がある。\n俺もふたりの会話に立ち会う。引き渡す瞬間: ...On top of that, I have a condition as well. I will also be present for your conversation. Until the moment of handover, I can't leave her alone.
聞き入れてくれるなら、こちらの機体の主機を落とそう。: If you accept, I will shut down our unit's main generator.
これでセンサー類の使用はできず、\n録音や通信もできない状態になる。: With this, the sensors will be unusable, leaving us in a state where we can't record or communicate.
――その後俺の機体とちゆる機、そしてコトハ機がそれぞれ近づき、\n停止するなりコ: —After that, my unit, Chiyuru's unit, and Kotoha's unit approached each other, coming to a halt and opening their cockpit hatches.
そのタイミングで、俺の指示によりシリウスシュガー全機は\n主機を落として機体を停: At that moment, following my instructions, all Sirius Sugar units shut down their main generators and brought their machines to a stop.
なお、この交渉に先立ち、\nジュリーは解放されて七彩機に回収されている。: Furthermore, prior to these negotiations, Julie was released and retrieved by Nanairo's unit.
こうして顔を合わせるのは初めてね。\n改めて『双頭の斧』のリーダー、コトハよ。: This is the first time we've met face-to-face like this. Allow me to introduce myself again—I'm Kotoha, leader of the Double-Headed Axe.
俺は生徒会付教導指揮官の%usernameusernameuserna%だ。: I'm %usernameusernameuserna%, attached to the Student Council as an Instructional Commander.
……龍宮ちゆる、と言った方がよかった？: ...Would it have been better if I said Tatsumiya Chiyuru?
どちらでも。私からは龍宮ちゆるとしか呼ばないから。: Either is fine. I'll only ever call you Tatsumiya Chiyuru anyway.
……そう。それにしても、先に人質を返してくれるなんて、\nどういう風の吹き回し？: ...I see. Still, handing over the hostage first—what brought this change of heart on?
一定の信用は築いておきたいと思ったの。\n私達は別に敵じゃないことを示すために。: I wanted to build a baseline of trust. To show that we aren't necessarily your enemies.
あんな乱暴な襲撃をしておいてか？: Even after launching such a violent attack?
あくまで『龍宮ちゆる』の敵じゃないってだけよ。: Only in the sense that we are not the enemy of 'Tatsumiya Chiyuru'.
私達の仲間になってほしいの、龍宮ちゆる。: I want you to join us, Tatsumiya Chiyuru.
やれやれ。キミもＴ２元素応用技術が目当て？\nあれを武器に応用したいの？: Good grief. Are you after T2 Element Application Technology too? Do you want to apply it to weapons?
いや、違う。あんたには研究をやめてもらう。\n未来永劫、私のそばで研究しないよう: No, you're wrong. I'm going to have you stop your research. For all eternity, I will keep you by my side and monitor you so that you don't research it.
Ｔ２元素応用技術は危険よ。\nあれを実用化させるわけにはいかない。: T2 Element Application Technology is dangerous. We can't allow it to be put into practical use.
危険だと主張する根拠は何？: What is the basis for your claim that it's dangerous?
根拠？ むしろそれを疑問に思わない、\nあんたの脳みその方が不思議だわ。: Basis? I find your brain even more baffling for not questioning it in the first place.
呆れたと言わんばかりにコトハの口元が歪む。: Kotoha's mouth warped in exasperation, as if to say she was utterly appalled.
Ｔ２元素応用技術……その本質は『重力』の操作にある。: T2 Element Application Technology... Its true essence lies in the manipulation of 'gravity'.
では、もしその技術が制御不能に陥ったら──何が起きる？: Then, if that technology were to fall out of control—what do you think would happen?
自明のことから話をしましょう。\nそっちの指揮官が付いてこられないみたいだし。: Let's start from the obvious. Since it seems your commander over there can't keep up.
お心遣い、痛み入るよ。: I'm deeply touched by your thoughtfulness.
メイズ内に通常の生物は長く滞在できない。: Normal living organisms cannot stay inside the Maze for long periods.
そこで暮らしているのは奇妙な変異を遂げた、\n化け物のようなメイズシフターだけよ: The only things living there are the monster-like Maze Shifters that have undergone strange mutations.
では何故そうなったのか？ それは全て――: Then why did they turn out like that? It is all because—
まるで地獄の底を見てきたような瞳がちゆるを捉える。: Eyes that looked as though they had peered into the depths of hell locked onto Chiyuru.
――メイズ内の重力異常が原因。: —The gravitational anomalies inside the Maze are the cause.
そういう主張があるのは知ってるよ。\nそしてそれは……事実だろうね。: I know that theory exists. And that... is likely the truth.
わかっていてその態度……？ ますます信じられないんだけど。: Knowing that, and yet you still have that attitude...? I find that even more unbelievable.
重力操作なんてものに手を出して、\nその使い方を誤ればどうなると思う？: Dabbling in something like gravity manipulation... What do you think happens if you misuse it?
今はメイズ内だけで起きている現象が、\n地上にまで広がってしまうでしょうね。: The phenomenon currently happening only inside the Maze would likely spread to the surface as well.
そうなれば――地上全てがメイズになる。\nそうなった時、あんたは責任を取れるの？: If that happens—the entire surface will become a Maze. When it comes to that, can you take responsibility?
コトハの糾弾を受けて、明らかにちゆるは狼狽していた。: Upon receiving Kotoha's condemnation, Chiyuru was visibly shaken.
それは……ありえる話なのか？: Is that... actually a plausible scenario?
否定しきれないってのが本音ね。可能性の話でしかないけれど、\n彼女の言っている懸: To be honest, I can't entirely deny it. While it's merely a matter of possibility, the concern she mentioned is indeed real.
（ちゆるがこの研究の第一人者だから詳しいのはわかる。\nでもコトハがここまで未発: (It makes sense for Chiyuru to be knowledgeable since she's the leading authority on this research. But why can Kotoha talk about such unannounced technology to this extent?)
でも……どんな技術にも危険性はある。ナイフや包丁と同じでね。: However... every technology carries danger. Just like knives or kitchen blades.
誰かを殺そうとその切っ先を人に向ければ武器になるし、\n食材に向ければそれは調理: If you point the blade at someone with the intent to kill, it becomes a weapon, but if you point it at ingredients, it's nothing more than a cooking tool.
所詮ツール――手段でしかないからね。\n大切なのは正しく扱う意志と知識を持つこと: Ultimately, it's just a tool—a means to an end. What matters is having the knowledge and the will to handle it correctly.
この交渉において、初めてコトハの表情が緩んだ。: For the first time during these negotiations, Kotoha's expression relaxed.
その考え方、私は嫌いじゃない。けど――: I don't dislike that way of thinking. However—
残念だけど、あんたは『誰がその刃を握るのか』を見ていない。: Unfortunately, you aren't looking at 'who holds that blade'.
私達の組織の名前は――『双頭の斧』。つまりは両刃斧。\nこの名前の意味ってわかる: The name of our organization is—'Double-Headed Axe'. In other words, a double-edged axe. Do you know the meaning behind this name?
さあね……斧は力の象徴ってイメージくらいしかないかな。: Who knows... The only image I really have is that an axe is a symbol of power.
そう、力の象徴。特に両刃斧の場合は常に一方の刃が敵を断つとき、\nもう一方の刃は: Yes, a symbol of power. Especially in the case of a double-edged axe, whenever one blade strikes down an enemy, the other blade is always facing toward oneself.
だからその斧を振るうには、\n己を律する強い意志と自制心がないといけない。: That is why, to swing that axe, one must possess a strong will and the self-restraint to discipline oneself.
少しでも扱い方を間違えれば、\nその刃は簡単に自分達の脅威になってしまうから。: Because if you mismanage it even a little, that blade will easily become a threat to yourselves.
なのに――今そんな力の象徴の柄を握ろうとしているのは、\nきっと『私達』ではない: And yet—the ones currently trying to grasp the shaft of that symbol of power are almost certainly 'not us'. That is the real problem.
一体、何を言っているの……？: What on earth are you talking about...?
なんだ、今の音は！？: What was that sound just now!?
一瞬、空を見たコトハがコックピットに飛び込む。\nそしてすぐさま機体に回避行動を: Looking up at the sky for a brief second, Kotoha dove into the cockpit. She immediately made her unit take evasive action.
直後、彼女の機体のあった場所に、炎が立ち上がる。: Immediately after, flames erupted where her unit had just been standing.
少なくともシリウスシュガーには無理だ。\n全ての機体が主電源を落としていたのだか: At the very least, it's impossible for Sirius Sugar. All of our units had shut down their main generators, after all.
ならば双頭の斧のＭＧによるものかとなるが、\n狙ったのがコトハの機体なのは解せな: If so, that would mean it was done by a Double-Headed Axe MG, but targeting Kotoha's unit makes no sense.
だとしたら可能性はひとつ。\n第三者の介入だ。: If that's the case, there's only one possibility. The intervention of a third party.
俺達もＭＧを起動させるぞ。: We're starting up our MGs too!
コックピットに飛び込んで主機を入れる。: I dove into the cockpit and switched on the main generator.
離れていた七彩達も非常事態と判断したのか\nＭＧを起動させている。: Judging it to be an emergency, Nanairo and the others who were further away are starting up their MGs as well.
やっぱり穏便に終わらせるのは無理だったか。: So settling this peacefully was impossible after all, huh.
少なくとも砲撃があるまではコトハと冷静な言葉のやり取りが\nできていただけに残念: It's truly a shame, especially since we were able to exchange calm words with Kotoha right up until the bombardment.
あいつら、撃ってきやがった！: Those guys actually shot at us!
双頭の斧下っ端機が発砲している。\nだが攻撃目標が定まっていないようでバラバラな: The Double-Headed Axe henchmen units are opening fire. However, their targets don't seem to be coordinated, leading to disorganized movements.
まずは七彩達と合流する！: First, we meet up with Nanairo and the others!
状況は乱戦へとなだれ込んでいた。: The situation cascaded into a melee battle.
